name: fingerprint-version
//: Proves llmlint's own version is part of `llmlint fingerprint` through the real CLI: the workspace's built llmlint and a second build from a scratch copy of this repository with only Cargo.toml's package version changed print different digests, while one build agrees with itself. Its own project because it compiles a second llmlint (into target/fingerprint-version), so no edit to the e2e suite pays for that. Edges: llmlint is the crate it builds and runs, llmlint-mock-oneharness the stand-in harness it runs against.

test.//: Its inputs are everything that can change its result and nothing else: the crate's sources and the assets it embeds, the manifest and lockfile, the build configuration, the stand-in harness, and this test. A repo-root edit outside them (README, justfile) replays it from the cache.
